audit_phase: Phase 8.1 - Advisory Engine Logic, Threshold and Data Provenance Audit

case_1_two_wet_days_inside_5d.description: Two rainy days inside 5-day window summing to 80 mm

case_2_two_wet_days_outside_5d.description: Two rainy days separated by 8 dry days summing to 80 mm

case_3_single_heavy_rain_day.description: Single heavy rainfall event (80 mm) without secondary rain

case_4_exactly_75mm.description: Exactly 75.0 mm cumulative with 2 wet days within 5 days

case_6_missing_in_verification_window.description: Missing observation inside 5-day verification window (>=75mm candidate)

rain_shadow_two_stage_trigger.bug_status: FIXED (Phase 8 seasonal rainy days bug resolved by strictly requiring qualifying_5d_wet_days >= 2)

cumulative_rainfall_definitions.may_rainfall_handling: Excluded by design. May pre-monsoon convective showers are high-evaporation ephemeral events not contributing to sustained profile recharge.
cumulative_rainfall_definitions.accumulation_type: Continuous cumulative summation (np.cumsum) from June 1 through current date.
cumulative_rainfall_definitions.rolling_vs_cumulative: Cumulative summation used for primary sowing triggers (50 mm / 75 mm); rolling 3-day and 5-day used for extreme precipitation hazard checks and dry spell tracking.

dry_spell_reset_limitation.issue: Continuous cumulative sum does not reset following extended dry spells.
dry_spell_reset_limitation.scenario: A 45 mm event on June 3 followed by 20 consecutive dry days (leading to complete topsoil desiccation) followed by 30 mm on June 24 reaches 75 mm cumulative total.
dry_spell_reset_limitation.agronomic_risk: Soil moisture from June 3 is completely lost via evaporation (ET0 > 5-7 mm/day). The 30 mm event is insufficient to wet the 15-20 cm root zone.
mitigating_controls: Two-stage verification requires qualifying rainy days within a 5-day window, preventing isolated older events from satisfying the multi-day persistence criterion.
Active post-trigger dry spell monitoring evaluates consecutive dry days and triggers HIGH RISK if dry run >= 7 days.
Disclaimer explicitly warns that rainfall thresholds do not model profile evapotranspiration or matric potential.
dry_spell_reset_limitation.required_production_enhancement: Operational field deployment must integrate a 1D soil-water balance model (e.g. FAO-56 dual crop coefficient or SWAT) to dynamically track available water capacity (AWC).

imd_timestamping_standard.reporting_timestamp: Rainfall recorded on Date D represents rain fallen between 08:30 IST of D-1 and 08:30 IST of D.
imd_timestamping_standard.operational_freshness_delay: Gridded IMD data typically has a 24-48 hour latency. Automated Weather Station (AWS) data requires immediate quality check and QC filtering.

risk_metric_1_post_50mm_break.statistic_name: Historical Probability of >=10-Day Dry Break within 20 Days of 50 mm Trigger
risk_metric_1_post_50mm_break.scientific_interpretation: Empirical historical conditional frequency (1 in 2.5 years) under past climate. It is an actuarial risk metric, NOT a live forecast for the current season.

risk_metric_2_unreached_75mm.statistic_name: Historical Frequency of Failing to Reach 75 mm Threshold by July 15
risk_metric_2_unreached_75mm.scientific_interpretation: In 20.60% of cell-years, 75 mm is not attained before July 15, requiring shift to contingency crops (Horsegram, Cowpea, Sunflower).

historical_risk_metrics.separation_validation: CONFIRMED: 39.13% desiccation hazard is strictly separate from the 20.60% non-triggering frequency. Neither is presented as a predictive forecast.

test_result.condition_name: Heavy-Rainfall Hazard Indicator (Potential Waterlogging / Drainage Risk)

maritime_heavy_rainfall.scientific_rationale: High-intensity rainfall in Konkan creates drainage congestion and nursery submergence hazards. However, actual waterlogging depends on slope, soil percolation, and drainage ditch maintenance.

data_provenance_tracking.audit_note: Prevents confusing synthetic demonstration scenarios with actual real-time weather observations.

soil_depth_classifications.shallow_soils: < 30 cm depth: Low water holding capacity (< 50 mm/m). Sowing permitted only for low-water pearl millet, horsegram, moth bean.
soil_depth_classifications.medium_soils: 30 - 60 cm depth: Medium water holding capacity (100-150 mm/m). Soybean, Cotton, Pigeonpea.
soil_depth_classifications.deep_vertisols: > 60 cm depth: High water holding capacity (180-220 mm/m). Requires >= 75 mm to wet top 15-20 cm due to high clay swelling and cracking.

post_july15_contingency_handling.trigger_date: July 15 (Standard agronomic cutoff for primary Kharif crops in Maharashtra)
post_july15_contingency_handling.advisory_behavior: Issues HIGH_RISK delayed sowing contingency advisory with explicit university alternative crop varieties.
post_july15_contingency_handling.cancellation_order_audit: CONFIRMED: Engine DOES NOT issue an automated Kharif cancellation order. It recommends contingency varieties and soil moisture conservation.

university_contingency_varieties.Rain-Shadow (MPKV Rahuri): Horsegram (Sina, Man), Cowpea (Phule Pandhari), Sunflower (Phule Bhaskar), Pearl Millet (Phule Aadishakti).
university_contingency_varieties.Marathwada (VNMKV Parbhani): Abort long-duration Bt Cotton / Soybean; plant short-duration Black gram (TAU-1), Green gram (BM-2003-2), Pigeonpea + Bajra (1:2).
university_contingency_varieties.Vidarbha (Dr. PDKV Akola): Contingency short-duration Pigeonpea (Asha, Maruti), Sesame (AKT-64), Sunflower (PKVSH-27).
university_contingency_varieties.Konkan (Dr. BSKKV Dapoli): Rice seedling re-nursery or community nurseries using early varieties (Karjat-3, Ratnagiri-1) if primary nurseries damaged.

documented_operational_limitations: Rainfall thresholds are precipitation accumulation markers, NOT direct measures of plant-available soil moisture (PAW).
Cumulative summation does not reset soil water balance following extended mid-season dry spells without an active soil water balance model.
Single convective thunderstorms are filtered via 5-day verification, but complex dry spells within Vertisol cracking zones require farm-level verification.
Historical risk metrics (39.13% break probability) represent 2001-2023 empirical climatology, NOT short-term numerical weather prediction (NWP) forecasts.
Precipitation hazard indicators (100 mm 1-day / 200 mm 3-day) do not evaluate local topography, drainage gradient, or ditch conditions.
